name: Glider → lamp
description: A History+Wave glider runs into a lamp: a region painted with c_damp = 0, so the glider's history trail (c) never fades there. The lamp lights up and stays lit after the glider has gone; the same trail elsewhere decays. Shown as b, tinted by the hidden reagent c. A one-shot latch: switching it back off needs a bistable memory.
